desc:
Welcome to Money Genius Island!
Test your knowledge about money in varied mini-games and
proof that you are a true money genius.

- Master exciting Obbies
- Collect coins and top up your bank account.
Build your own tycoons and earn more coins with them.
- Experience how your money grows through interest.
Exchange currencies (e.g. yen ↔ euro) and learn about exchange rates in practice.

Travel to mysterious places, participate in challenges, and secure rewards.
exclusive event items - available at participating banks.

Good luck and have fun discovering Money Genius Island!
